name: WebMon
tagline: Interactive Web Component Picker, Resizable Desktop & iOS Home/Lock Screen Widgets, Cross-Device iCloud Sync & Local Auth Vault
short_description: Native macOS, iOS & Windows 11 interactive web browser and visual DOM component selector that pins any website component as a resizable floating desktop widget or iOS Home/Lock Screen widget with Sign in with Apple cross-device sync, live cadence auto-refresh, custom background fills/gradients/wallpapers, pan & zoom framing, and local Keychain credential vault.
spotlight_description: WebMon v2.1 brings live web component pinning across macOS, iOS (Home Screen, Lock Screen & StandBy), and Windows 11. Open any website in the built-in WebKit browser, tap or click to select one or more DOM components, and pin them as resizable Liquid Glass desktop widgets or iOS Home & Lock Screen widgets that refresh automatically on your custom cadence (5s to 60m). Sign in with Apple to sync custom widgets, DOM selectors, backgrounds (Theme, Solid Color, Gradient & Wallpaper), pan/zoom framing, and Lock Screen typography across Mac and iPhone via iCloud. Includes toggleable Header & Footer chrome (or 100% full-card edge-to-edge bleed), persistent sign-in sessions, a local Keychain credential vault, 8-style telemetry cards, and Low Effort Suite theme & Dock icon sync.
catalog_description: Native macOS & iOS WebKit component clipper, resizable floating desktop & Home/Lock Screen widget engine, live cadence refresh scheduler, Sign in with Apple cross-device iCloud sync, and local Keychain credential vault engineered in Swift 6. Features an interactive DOM element picker with scroll-anchored bounding-box overlays, multi-component widget composition, toggleable Header & Footer chrome with 100% full-card edge-to-edge bleed, custom Solid/Gradient/Wallpaper widget backgrounds, pan & zoom viewport framing, Lock Screen DOM typography widgets, and Low Effort Suite theme & icon sync.
